description: This file defines API routes for cart operations in an Express.js backend, including endpoints to get, add, update, remove items, and clear the shopping cart, utilizing middleware for authentication and referencing a controller module.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware to enforce authentication on cart routes.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Controller method to retrieve the current active cart.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Controller method to add a new item to the cart.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Controller method to update item quantities in the cart.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Controller method to remove a specific item from the cart.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Controller method to clear all items from the cart.
